description: Whether a foreign document needs a certified translation for an authority in Spain, Germany, France, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, Denmark, Norway or Finland, who may certify it there, and whether it needs an apostille or consular legalisation given the country that issued it. Answers come only from PapeleoYa network guides (with links); anything they do not cover is returned as "unknown" with the closest guide. Use for questions like "Do I need a sworn translation of my Moroccan birth certificate for Spanish citizenship?" or "Apostille or legalisation for Pakistani documents in Norway?".

destination.description: Country where the translated document will be USED (submitted to an authority): Spain, Germany, France, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, Denmark, Norway or Finland. Name or ISO code, e.g. "Spain" or "ES".

document_language.description: Language the document is written in (code or English name), if known.

origin_country.description: Country that ISSUED the document (name or ISO code), e.g. "Morocco", "PK".

procedure.description: What the document is for, e.g. "residence permit", "citizenship", "marriage", "degree recognition", "driving licence exchange", "family reunification".

name: check_document_requirements
title: Check translation & apostille requirements
